about_the_game:
Chaotic Kickers
A Multiplayer Party Soccer Brawl Where Rules Don’t Exist!

About the Game:
Chaotic Kickers throws out the rulebook and brings you a 3v3 multiplayer soccer experience full of trolls, goofy characters, and pure chaos. With no referees, no VAR, and no sportsmanship, the only goal is to score 5 points before the other team—by any means necessary.

Key Features:

  • 3v3 PvP Party Action: Team up with friends or go head-to-head in fast-paced matches of total mayhem.

  • Unique Classes & Abilities: Every character comes with wild powers to kick, dash, tackle, or completely mess with the other team.

  • Stylized Goofy Chaos: Cute but slightly evil characters bring charm (and pain) to every match.

  • No Rules, Only Mayhem: Forget fair play—anything goes in this arena of madness.

  • Pure Party Energy – Easy to pick up, hard to stop laughing.

Join the Madness!
Are you ready to kick, dash, and troll your way to victory? Grab your squad, embrace the chaos, and score the most ridiculous goals ever!
